environment: temporary local HTTP server and headless Chromium
fallback: A captured resource-error listener handles every non-async script during initial parsing and presents retry plus full-ZIP unpack guidance.
separation: CNN result shards are appended with script.async=true in cnn-results-loader.js, so this handler does not replace their dedicated error path or the saved-session restore screen.
fileProtocol: Normal file:// boot was previously observed with no HTTP(S) requests; this change adds no fetch.
